death.attack.neosync.fingerstick.en: %s died in the name of science

gui.neosync.shell_selector.rename.hint.en: Enter to save, Esc to cancel
gui.neosync.shell_selector.rename.hint.zh: 回车保存, Esc 取消

jei.neosync.info.guide.en: The NeoSync Guide explains the whole shell loop, from crafting a Sync Core to syncing between bodies, plus the commands, config and mod integrations. Craft it from a book and three redstone, or hold the GuideMe hotkey over any NeoSync item to jump to its page.
jei.neosync.info.guide.zh: NeoSync 指南讲解了完整的躯壳循环, 从合成同步核心到在躯体之间同步, 还包括命令, 配置与模组联动.用一本书和三个红石合成, 或在任意 NeoSync 物品上按住 GuideMe 快捷键以跳转到对应页面.

jei.neosync.info.manual_shell_storage.en: A Shell Storage whose stored shell is never chosen automatically when you die. Use it for bodies built for one job. Walk in to sync into it by hand like any other storage.
jei.neosync.info.manual_shell_storage.zh: 一种躯壳存储器, 其中存放的躯壳在你死亡时不会被自动选中.适合为单一用途打造的躯体.像其他存储器一样走进去即可手动同步.

jei.neosync.info.shell_constructor.en: Place the Shell Constructor, supply it with energy via a Treadmill (or any FE source), then right-click it to begin constructing a new shell from your genetic sample. Warning: the sampling process deals damage. Sneak and right-click with a dye to color its trim; shells built inside take that color in the shell menu.
jei.neosync.info.shell_constructor.zh: 放置壳体培育仓，通过跑步机（或任何FE能源）为它供能，然后右击它开始用你的基因样本构建新的壳体。注意：采样过程会造成伤害。

jei.neosync.info.shell_storage.en: Place a Shell Storage and supply it with redstone power (or FE). Walk into it when the doors are open to pull up the radial shell menu and transfer your mind into a stored shell. Sneak and right-click with a dye to color its trim and the shell stored inside.
jei.neosync.info.shell_storage.zh: 放置一个壳体存放仓，并为它提供红石能量（或FE）。当门打开时进入其中，就可以调出环形壳体菜单，并将你的意识同步到存放的壳体中。

jei.neosync.info.sync_core.en: The Sync Core is the key component in every shell-related block. Combine it with gray concrete to craft a Shell Constructor or a Shell Storage.
jei.neosync.info.sync_core.zh: 同步核心是壳体机器的关键部件。把它和灰色混凝土结合起来，可以合成壳体培育仓或壳体存放仓。

jei.neosync.info.treadmill.en: Two-block structure. Lure a pig, wolf, or other supported animal onto the front block and it will generate energy that neighbouring Shell Constructors / Storages will consume.
jei.neosync.info.treadmill.zh: 双方块结构。把猪、狼或其他支持的动物引到前面的方块上，它会产生能量，附近的壳培育仓/存放仓会消耗这些能量。

jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_constr.en: A Shell Constructor powered by zero-point energy. Requires no external power and finishes new shells instantly. The sampling process still deals damage. Sneak and right-click with a dye to recolor its cyan trim; shells built inside take that color in the shell menu.
jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_constr.zh: 由零点能量驱动的躯壳构造器.无需外部供能, 并可瞬间完成新躯壳.采样过程仍会造成伤害.手持染料潜行右击可为其青色饰边重新着色; 在其中制作的躯壳会在躯壳菜单中采用该颜色.

jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_storag.en: A Shell Storage powered by zero-point energy. Requires no redstone or FE. Its doors open automatically as you approach and stored shells never decay. Sneak and right-click with a dye to recolor its cyan trim and the shell stored inside.
jei.neosync.info.zero_point_shell_storag.zh: 由零点能量驱动的躯壳存储器.无需红石或 FE.靠近时其门会自动打开, 存放的躯壳永不腐坏.手持染料潜行右击可为其青色饰边及内部存放的躯壳重新着色.
